homepage.headline: Ava for Reddit (beta)
homepage.subheadline: Ava is a fully native Reddit client for iOS, inspired by the best of Apollo and built from the ground up with Swift and SwiftUI. Every detail is handcrafted to feel fast, clean, and unmistakably iOS. Ava focuses on what matters most: speed, privacy, deep customizability, and a polished user experience — without tracking, data collection, or compromises.
